title: Generator overrides
description: The only hand-maintained generator input. Every entry is a reviewed decision; an entry that matches nothing fails generation.

unions.description: IR path -> C# type for a construct the type mapping cannot map (union, any, unknown, a template property whose kind differs across backends). Value: a fully qualified hand-written type such as Graspea.Flint.ContinuousMarkCrossSection, or JsonNode for an explicitly accepted opaque member.

flatten.description: IR paths of mapped types (Omit, Pick, Partial of a non-reference) accepted as a generated class <Parent><Prop> with the checker-resolved members.

dedup.description: Fully qualified hand-written type -> IR paths of inline objects that are structurally identical to it (ChartSize: required numeric width and height).

renames.description: IR path (type member, catalog constant, or <Template>/property/<key>, <Template>/channel/<channel>, <Template>/enum/<key>, <Template>/enum/<key>/<value>) -> C# name. Template paths rename the builder method of a channel or property, the enum of a discrete property, or one enum member (the value is the raw string, or the JSON of another value); the wire value never changes.

docs.description: IR path (type or type member) -> remark text for a fact the d.ts gets wrong or omits.

backendsApplyingTheme.description: Backends that read theme_spec (backed by the recorded probe); copied into IR catalog.

hostStateKeys.description: chartProperties keys read even where a template does not declare them; copied into IR catalog.

ignoredOptions.description: AssembleOptions member -> backends that overwrite it; copied into IR catalog and the member docs.

imageChartsChannels.description: Image-Charts has no template registry: chart type (an own key of IMAGE_CHARTS_TYPE_MAP) -> the channels its template declares, which are the channels assembleImageCharts reads that another backend of the template also declares, so that no builder gains a member. column and row are left out (the assembler throws on a bound facet). The keys must equal the map's keys, unless pending lists catalog.chartTypes[<type>].backends.image-charts; copied into IR catalog.

imageChartsReads.description: Chart type of IMAGE_CHARTS_TYPE_MAP -> the channels assembleImageCharts reads, as the read probe of src/extract/channel-reads.ts finds them: binding the channel to a text or a number field, or removing it from the base, changes the URL or the throw, under a synthetic base the chart type assembles from (the fixtures step probes the fixture bases too and records every base in probes.json channelReads). extract fails when the probe finds other channels, so that a change in a src/core helper the fingerprinted Image-Charts files call is reviewed too: review the Image-Charts throw rules, imageChartsChannels and the undeclared-read exemptions, then record the probed channels. Every imageChartsChannels channel must be read. The keys must equal the map's keys, unless pending lists catalog.chartTypes[<type>].backends.image-charts.

imageChartsSource.description: The reviewed sha256 (lowercase hex) of src/image-charts/assemble.ts and src/image-charts/chart-types.ts of the pinned flint-chart, the files the hand-written Image-Charts parts are read from: the throw rules (src/Graspea.Flint/Validation/Rules/ImageCharts.cs), imageChartsChannels and the channels the validator knows Image-Charts reads though its template leaves them undeclared. Extraction fails when the installed files differ; review those parts against the new files, then record the new values.

pending.description: IR paths of entries written ahead for a flint-chart version that is not pinned yet: such an entry may match nothing. Once the pin has the path the entry applies like any other; remove the path from this list then.

keepObsolete.description: Rename paths whose old shipped name is kept as an [Obsolete] FLINT0002 member.
